svg.title: IPv4 and TCP headers
svg.desc: Left: the IPv4 header from RFC 791, 32 bits per row: Version, IHL, Type of Service, Total Length; Identification, Flags, Fragment Offset; Time to Live, Protocol, Header Checksum; Source Address; Destination Address; Options, Padding. Right: the TCP header from RFC 793: Source Port, Destination Port; Sequence Number; Acknowledgment Number; Data Offset, Reserved, the URG, ACK, PSH, RST, SYN, and FIN flags, Window; Checksum, Urgent Pointer; Options, Padding; then data.
